_comment: Copy to config.json (private, git-ignored). Keys come from environment variables: LEDGER_TRADER_KEY and the model key named in model_adapter.api_key_env. Each team member sets their own symbol and theory version.

expected_theory._note: Pin the validated strategy/version/params. Momentum needs its own validated settings, not the mean-reversion presets.

model_adapter._note: REQUIRED (course rule). Key only in the environment variable named by api_key_env, never in this file. Other providers: {"provider":"openai","model":"...","api_key_env":"OPENAI_API_KEY"} or {"provider":"anthropic",...}.
